# Implementation Plan: CRM Courtier Pro/Enterprise AssurMatch

**Branch**: `004-crm-courtier-pro` | **Date**: 2026-04-26 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/004-crm-courtier-pro/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan is generated by `/speckit.plan` and is followed immediately by `/speckit.tasks` and `/speckit.implement` per user request.

## Summary

Implement a broker CRM for Pro and Enterprise partners inside `apps/broker` and backend broker-facing modules. The CRM adds Kanban/list lead views, controlled pipeline, lead detail, internal notes, tasks, reminders, same-tenant advisor assignment, internal/prospect document metadata, non-contractual proposal references, won/lost/duplicate/unreachable/disputed outcomes, dashboard, scoped CSV export, minimal internal notifications and future AI placeholders. The feature reuses 001-003 foundations and does not add any CRM route to `apps/public`.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Node.js 24.15.0+; TypeScript 6.0.3 strict; Next.js 16.2.4; React 19.2.5; NestJS-style modular backend classes.
**Primary Dependencies**: Zod shared contracts; Prisma 7.8.0 schema target; Vitest 4.1.5; Playwright 1.59.1; existing audit, feature flag, lead assignment and RBAC utilities.
**Storage**: PostgreSQL durable model via Prisma. Current implementation layer keeps in-memory service patterns for tests, with Prisma schema prepared for CRM tables.
**Testing**: Vitest unit/integration/contract/guardrail tests and Playwright broker smoke tests through `npm run test:web`.
**Target Platform**: Back-office Partenaires/Plateforme, Backend API and shared contracts.
**Impacted Application(s)**: Back-office Partenaires/Plateforme: yes. Backend API: yes. Shared packages: yes. Web Publique Client: no route/layout/page changes.
**Project Type**: B2B2C regulated insurance marketplace technical platform.
**Performance Goals**: CRM list/dashboard responses remain bounded by pagination/filtering; exports default to controlled max rows; no heavy synchronous AI or regulated workflow.
**Constraints**: Pro/Enterprise only; Starter denied; `broker_crm_enabled` required; strict tenant and RBAC controls; no sale, subscription, premium collection, e-signature, policy issuance, attestation, claims, insurer API or binding recommendation.
**Scale/Scope**: Pilot CRM for partner organization with owner/manager/agent/read-only roles and future Enterprise extensions.

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Passed before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

- **Technical platform role**: Pass. CRM tracks partner follow-up only and cannot issue contracts or official recommendations.
- **Regulatory and consent**: Pass. CRM consumes already assigned leads; no new public consent or routing path is introduced.
- **Application separation**: Pass. UI changes are limited to `apps/broker`; no public route, layout or authenticated state is added to `apps/public`.
- **Feature flags and activation**: Pass. `broker_crm_enabled` gates all CRM access. Future AI placeholders respect existing AI flags and default to no model call.
- **Security and RBAC**: Pass. Access policy checks plan, MFA, roles, partner tenant, assignment scope and mutation/export permissions.
- **Data and auditability**: Pass. Sensitive actions write AuditLog and pipeline history. Notes/documents remain internal-only.
- **Routing integrity**: Pass. Internal assignment cannot change broker tenant and does not reroute leads between brokers.
- **AI control**: Pass. Foundations only; no advice, recommendation or automated decision.
- **Testing discipline**: Pass. Tasks include RBAC, tenant isolation, Starter denial, export denial, audit, guardrail and Playwright coverage.

**Post-Design Constitution Check**: Pass. Design artifacts keep CRM inside back-office/backend/shared contracts, preserve public separation and document all sensitive controls.

## Backend Architecture Plan

- Extend `LeadAssignmentRecord` with CRM status, priority/urgency/source, assigned advisor, tags and CRM metadata while keeping existing Starter statuses compatible.
- Add `BrokerCrmAccessPolicy` for Pro/Enterprise plan, `broker_crm_enabled`, RBAC, role scope and tenant isolation.
- Add `BrokerCrmLeadsService` for list, Kanban, detail, dashboard and export.
- Add `BrokerCrmPipelineService` for controlled transitions and status history.
- Add `BrokerCrmActivityService` for notes, tasks, reminders, same-tenant advisor assignment, internal documents, proposal references and disputes.
- Add `BrokerCrmNotificationsService` for minimal internal notifications.
- Add `BrokerCrmController` thin surface under `/broker/crm/*`.
- Extend `QuoteAuditActions` with `broker_crm.*` actions.
- Extend `packages/shared/contracts/quote.contracts.ts` with CRM schemas.
- Extend RBAC role matrix with `broker_crm:*` read/update/export/manage permissions.

## API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Purpose |
|--------|----------|---------|
| GET | `/broker/crm/dashboard` | Scoped pipeline counters and activity summary. |
| GET | `/broker/crm/leads` | Paginated table list with filters/search. |
| GET | `/broker/crm/leads/kanban` | Kanban grouped by controlled pipeline statuses. |
| GET | `/broker/crm/leads/:leadId` | Full CRM lead detail for authorized scope. |
| POST | `/broker/crm/leads/:leadId/status` | Controlled pipeline status transition. |
| POST | `/broker/crm/leads/:leadId/notes` | Add internal note. |
| POST | `/broker/crm/leads/:leadId/tasks` | Add commercial task. |
| POST | `/broker/crm/leads/:leadId/reminders` | Add reminder. |
| POST | `/broker/crm/leads/:leadId/assign` | Assign/reassign to advisor in same tenant. |
| POST | `/broker/crm/leads/:leadId/documents` | Add internal document metadata. |
| POST | `/broker/crm/leads/:leadId/proposals` | Add non-contractual proposal/reference. |
| POST | `/broker/crm/leads/:leadId/disputes` | Contest billed/invalid lead when applicable. |
| GET | `/broker/crm/leads/export.csv` | Permission-limited CSV export. |
| GET | `/broker/crm/notifications` | Minimal internal CRM notifications. |
| GET | `/broker/crm/ai-foundations` | Future AI availability metadata, no model call. |

## Prisma Data Plan

- Extend `LeadAssignmentStatus` with CRM pipeline values if durable enum parity is needed: `new`, `accepted_crm`, `contact_attempted`, `qualified`, `documents_requested`, `quote_preparing`, `quote_sent`, `negotiation`, `won`, `lost`, `duplicate`, `unreachable`, `out_of_target`, `rejected_disputed`.
- Add durable target models: `BrokerCrmLeadState`, `BrokerCrmPipelineHistory`, `BrokerCrmNote`, `BrokerCrmTask`, `BrokerCrmReminder`, `BrokerCrmDocument`, `BrokerCrmProposal`, `BrokerCrmDispute`, `BrokerCrmNotification`, `BrokerCrmAiAssistRequest`.
- All new models include `partnerTenantId`, timestamps, actor fields where applicable and tenant indexes.
- Migration can be lightweight in this increment because current services are in-memory, but `prisma validate` must pass.

## Frontend Broker App Plan

- `apps/broker/app/crm/page.tsx`: dashboard and Kanban first screen for Pro/Enterprise CRM.
- `apps/broker/app/crm/leads/page.tsx`: dense table view with filters, search, export state and permission messaging.
- `apps/broker/app/crm/leads/[leadAssignmentId]/page.tsx`: detail view with pipeline, history, notes, tasks, reminders, assignment, documents, proposals and dispute controls.
- Keep Starter pages intact and clearly separate from CRM routes.
- Do not modify `apps/public`.

## Tests Plan

- Unit: CRM access policy, role scope, status transitions, export policy, activity service and dashboard grouping.
- Integration: list/Kanban/detail/status/note/task/reminder/assignment/export/dispute tenant isolation and audit.
- Contract: Zod/OpenAPI coverage for `/broker/crm/*`.
- Guardrails: Starter denial, disabled flag denial, no public CRM routes, no regulated words/actions, no AI model call by default.
- Playwright: broker CRM dashboard/list/detail smoke and Starter blocked state.
